metadata_feature_policy: Reader separates labels, weights, IDs, groups, role, revision and finite scope from the validated request/caption input; only request/caption text normalization is called. Metadata separation does not remove caption style or fixed ordering.

candidate_position.fixed_index_one_top1_arithmetic: 14/16 = 87.5% on the frozen ordered development rows; arithmetic baseline, not a measured model or heldout score

caption_style.source_observation: Reference captions closely restate the request's desired behavior; negative captions often contain phrases such as but, losing, ignores, exposes or continues after. This is visible in the immutable first-nine catalog captions.
caption_style.claim: A text model could learn phrasing cues without learning the broader execution contract. Fixed finite observations justify these labels only within their declared scope.

proposed_later_controls_not_performed: Use a separate immutable evaluation artifact with candidate permutations and labels/IDs permuted together; preserve the original sixteen training rows.
Report fixed-order, majority-label and lexical baselines beside model scores; do not use this training set as heldout evidence.
Create independently reviewed paraphrases that reduce reference-versus-negative style cues, retaining exact evidence references and assigning a separate text revision.
Keep all connected source-family groups together when selecting later evaluation roles; splitting rows from groups77/78 into nominal train/test would not establish unseen-source generalization.
scope: No relabeling, role changes, family creation, paraphrase adoption, shuffled evaluation, model run or accuracy claim was performed here.
